armA_groups_note: generated candidates were sampled as P(x|1kb prompt) but are scored here as unconditional P(x), the same treatment every other group gets
real_minus_own_dinuc_shuffle_note: the one comparison in this work that is neither circular nor cross-species: real sequence against its own composition-matched scramble, paired by window. A positive interval excluding zero means the model reads structure above dinucleotide composition. It does NOT mean the model read cis-regulatory syntax.
species_contrast_VOID_FOR_BIOLOGY: Not interpretable as evolutionary or regulatory difference. Three confounds each independently predict zebrafish > flyingfish: (1) GRCz11 is in Evo 2's training corpus and GCA_018398805.1 almost certainly is not, so this contrasts memorisation against out-of-distribution generalisation; (2) the zebrafish windows are TSS-anchored while the flyingfish windows sit upstream of a predicted start codon from a CDS-only GeneWise model, with no TSS/UTR, so they may be UTR intron or intergenic sequence; (3) flyingfish GC runs systematically higher. The sign carries no information.
armA_generated_excluding_degenerate_note: degenerate candidates score near zero log-prob and would inflate the candidate mean as a pure artefact, so the gated row is the one to read
